text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
(The crowd's enthusiasm is—already 
incredible! But... ngh, it's still, still 
not enough...!)

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
...Reach! Please reach! Straight to your 
heart!

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: Yaaaaaaaaaaaaaaahhhhh!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: In 1st place, Victoire Pisa!!!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: "...Pisa-san...! Thank you very much...!"

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
"I'm frustrated, but... even more than 
that, my heart is just so full...!"

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
"My heart is burning, helplessly so. I 
can't forget anything, and that's exactly 
why—"
(Uwooooooooooah!!)

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: What... what incredible cheers...!

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: ...Yes, yes...!

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Smiles, excitement, and passion—a true 
sense of unity. It's a grand, massive 
circle...!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: ...Hk, hehehe! Yes...!

The two of them raised their hands high 
into the air, sending the roaring crowd 
into an even greater frenzy.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, Pisa! Thank you, Buena! 
—Everyone!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Racing really is the best! I want everyone 
to feel this rush...!!

text_block_list.name: Rose Fan
text_block_list.text: Ah... I'm so glad I came to watch today!

"Beneath the cold winter sky, the 
Umamusume basked in roaring cheers—"

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: ...Congratulations, Pisa.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: And... thank you.
Great emotion, excitement, and—

text_block_list.name: Pisa's Old Friend A
text_block_list.text: ...Pisa won the Arima Kinen...

text_block_list.name: Pisa's Old Friend A
text_block_list.text:
...Ngh, ugh! Uuuu~...! That was amazing! 
Aww, seriously~...!!

Along with a new hope, the "Arima Kinen" 
came to a close.

text_block_list.name: LANE from Old Friend A
text_block_list.text:
"Pisa! Congratulations on winning the 
Arima Kinen!"

text_block_list.name: LANE from Old Friend A
text_block_list.text:
"I was so happy. I thought it'd just be 
painful, but... ...I was truly happy."

text_block_list.name: LANE from Old Friend A
text_block_list.text: "And then, you know—"

text_block_list.name: LANE from Old Friend A
text_block_list.text:
"I think I'll try running again too. 
Starting from amateur races, one step at a 
time."

text_block_list.name: LANE from Old Friend A
text_block_list.text:
"My dream right now is to run in a race 
together with Pisa again someday. ...Just 
kidding."

text_block_list.name: LANE from Old Friend A
text_block_list.text: "Thank you for keeping on running."

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: —Fufu, no, I'm sorry. ...Um.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
May I stay in the waiting room just a 
little longer? Until my heart... calms 
down...

The emotions stirred by that day's Arima 
Kinen lingered everywhere, becoming the 
talk of the town.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Another long line has formed at the 
Umamusume Shop today. Everyone is after 
the Pisa plushie.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Your name is featured boldly across all 
media, and on Umatwitt, you continue to 
reign over the sports trends.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
"Racing is so exciting!" "It was like a 
concert, I got so hyped!" "Watching the 
Arima Kinen might become my new year-end 
tradition"—

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Even people who had never engaged with 
racing before started taking an 
interest—you... truly pulled it off.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
You accomplished something truly 
tremendous. Everyone ought to recognize 
that, shouldn't they?

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: Yes, I believe I understand.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
...Is that true? Really? Considering 
that... you look pretty calm.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: It's simply in my nature.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
...I see. That's fine then. Got it. 
Anyway, you did great. ...Later.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: ...Well now.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Ruler-san is very happy, you know.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
The fact that you, my fellow classmate, 
are now the center of attention across all 
of Japan.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: ...Yes. Fufu, it feels a little ticklish.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
"...Now then, shall we talk about what 
comes next?"

To begin with, the reason we set our 
sights on the Arima Kinen was triggered by 
the mysterious words left behind by Neo 
Universe.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: Bigger, even bigger. 'Maysa'—bring 'Hope.'

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"We can ‘weave’ it. —From ‘HPED’, to 
‘HPED’."

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
An even greater hope... I am certain we 
have accomplished that.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
"If so, is there truly nothing left for me 
to do?"

Though she merely whispered it... there 
was a clear certainty in her expression.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: ...I'm sure that's how it is.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
From the circle of our peers to a circle 
reaching far beyond the racetrack. As I 
kept racing, there were things that 
finally became clear to me.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Even in the Senior Class, you might find 
connections you never noticed before.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
If there's even a chance I could find it, 
I'd like to take... just a few more steps 
forward.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
As long as you are all fulfilled, that is 
enough. If you find something that needs 
doing, I hope I can lend a hand once more.

If we continue as we have up until now... 
what needs to be done remains the same.

――There's a race that serves as the 
perfect precursor to the G1.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
"Nakayama Kinen"... That's the GII race 
held in February, right?

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: Understood. Let us definitely do so.

Overcoming one hurdle—on to the next 
brilliance.

The map may be unfinished, but our next 
destination lies at the foot of the 
mountain: the Nakayama Kinen.
